text_block_list.text:
One day, after a chaotic string of 
training sessions and meetings, I was 
finally catching my breath when—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Why is this room in such utter disarray? 
The accumulated dust, the trash, the 
towering stacks of documents...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I intended to return to work immediately 
after handing out the materials, but... 
there is a change of plans.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
A cluttered room reflects a cluttered 
mind. I will help you, so let us clean it 
right away.

An impromptu, one-on-one cleaning 
masterclass suddenly began.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Open the windows, get the trash bags 
ready! First, we tackle the desks!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Throw away what you don't need! Keep small 
items organized! ...And stop leaving paper 
clips loose in the drawer!

Thanks to those strict yet precise 
instructions, the cleaning proceeded 
efficiently—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We've sorted through most of it. 
All that's left is taking out the trash 
and organizing the documents.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Since we've come this far, let us assist 
until the very end. We shall take on 
either task.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Understood. ...Just to be safe, I'll do 
some warm-ups before getting started.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Kh...! As if something like this could 
stop me...!

And just like that, the Trainer's office 
was tidied up spotless.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. As fellow staff 
members of this academy, cooperating with 
one another is only natural. Well then, if 
you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...I'm gonna be so sore tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Organizing is normally a 
strength of mine, but... this volume looks 
daunting.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Keep, toss, unsure, toss, keep, unsure. I 
knew there'd be a lot, but wow……

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...To think it would take this much time. 
We should soon consider abolishing 
information sharing on paper.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
May I report the findings from this 
experience to the URA higher-ups?

A few days later, a survey regarding 
information sharing via paper media was 
circulated.
